BiblicalUsage: The net is the fisherman's dragnet, and Habakkuk uses it for the wicked who haul whole nations in and then worship the net itself. Isaiah has the same picture at the Nile, where the fishers cast their nets into the river and the work fails when God dries it up.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the net is a picture of power that forgets God: men who catch everything soon start worshipping the catching, and the Lord will not let that stand.
